title: Execution Capsule and provider-consent Context Kernel governance

phases.objective: Prove the complete default-off synthetic mutation-dispatch-to-rollout-readback journey without granting runtime or Production authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Execution Capsule mutation dispatch integration boundary
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A reversible mutation dispatch is accepted only with complete current evidence, and rollout or legacy retirement remains gated by exact approval, executor readback, and rollback evidence.
steps: Build an immutable Execution Capsule and reversible mutation operation contract
Refresh and bind approval, capability, authority, resource, provider, connection, and expected-SHA evidence
Project a secret-safe dispatch envelope and execute the bounded synthetic mutation adapter
Evaluate rollout and legacy-retirement readiness with exact executor readback and rollback controls
assertions: Incomplete, stale, mismatched, substituted, or secret-like evidence fails closed
Dispatch input remains bound to the exact tenant, workspace, brand, resource, connection, and expected SHA
Readiness evaluation cannot retire a legacy resolver or grant runtime authority automatically
The synthetic journey returns bounded readback and rollback evidence
Post-merge main readback records the exact merge and complete slice manifests while runtime authority and Production activation remain false

phases.objective: Resolve and certify provider-consent adapter evidence through the application and SQL adapter boundaries without exposing credentials or granting provider-write authority.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Registry adapters, certified evidence, non-production credential envelopes, handoff storage, and provider exchange projections resolve to one secret-safe readiness decision while unsupported or uncertified adapters fail closed.
steps: Load the Context Kernel application and SQL adapter registries
Resolve provider-consent adapter evidence and certification guards
Bind a non-production credential envelope without returning secret material
Persist and reread the non-production handoff contract
Evaluate provider-exchange readiness and return bounded evidence
assertions: Only registered and certified adapters can satisfy readiness
Credential envelopes expose references and policy evidence but never credential values
Non-production handoff and provider exchange remain explicitly environment-bound
Missing, stale, mismatched, or uncertified evidence fails closed
Application and SQL registry barrels export the same governed adapter contract

phases.objective: Reconcile provider-consent unknown outcomes with durable evidence, idempotent recovery, and fail-closed isolation from Production authority.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An ambiguous provider exchange is reconciled from bounded handoff and adapter evidence, returns one deterministic recovery decision, and never repeats an unsafe external mutation or promotes non-production authority.
steps: Load the ambiguous provider exchange and durable handoff evidence
Validate adapter certification, environment, identity, and evidence freshness
Classify the outcome as confirmed, retryable, blocked, or unresolved
Return idempotent recovery guidance and bounded readback evidence
Keep Production activation and provider-write authority disabled
assertions: Unknown outcomes are never treated as success without provider or durable readback evidence
Reconciliation cannot reuse credentials or evidence from another tenant, resource, connection, or environment
Repeated reconciliation returns a stable decision and does not repeat a provider mutation
Incomplete or conflicting evidence remains blocked with an explicit reason
No recovery path grants Production authority or includes secrets

phases.objective: Run the governed provider-consent and Execution Capsule journeys against an authorized live non-production target.
Verify exact Production SHA, certified adapter readiness, and runtime readback under separate release authorization.
